fullText.simplified:
耳等

    刘备一边穿衣服，一边跑到外面。出到外面一看，他笑了。城外不是吕布的军队，是曹操的军队。曹操来了！刘备没想到曹操只用了四天就到了这里，他高兴极了。
    吕布看到曹操的军队，知道自己一定打不过曹操，所以就决定先带军队回徐州，等一等再打。
    在回徐州的路上，吕布想了很久，还是觉得很奇怪：不应该啊！曹操在河南，他们要来这里，最快也要十天啊。为什么现在才四天，曹操就到了呢？太奇怪了！这是为什么？
    吕布边走边想，军队到了徐州市外。城门关着，吕布觉得更奇怪了：耳等知道我回来，为什么不开门呢？他对着城门大叫道：“耳等，是我！快开城门！”
    城门还是没开，吕布听到了耳等的笑声。只见耳等在城门上面，看着吕布，大声说：“徐州已经是曹将军的了，你如果不想死，就快走吧！”
    吕布不敢相信：“什么？你说什么？”
fullText.traditional:
耳等

    劉備一邊穿衣服，一邊跑到外面。出到外面一看，他笑了。城外不是呂布的軍隊，是曹操的軍隊。曹操來了！劉備沒想到曹操只用了四天就到了這裡，他高興極了。
    呂布看到曹操的軍隊，知道自己一定打不過曹操，所以就決定先帶軍隊回徐州，等一等再打。
    在回徐州的路上，呂布想了很久，還是覺得很奇怪：不應該啊！曹操在河南，他們要來這裡，最快也要十天啊。為什麼現在才四天，曹操就到了呢？太奇怪了！這是為什麼？
    呂布邊走邊想，軍隊到了徐州市外。城門關著，呂布覺得更奇怪了：耳等知道我回來，為什麼不開門呢？他對著城門大叫道：“耳等，是我！快開城門！”
    城門還是沒開，呂布聽到了耳等的笑聲。只見耳等在城門上面，看著呂布，大聲說：“徐州已經是曹將軍的了，你如果不想死，就快走吧！”
    呂布不敢相信：“什麼？你說什麼？”

sentences.traditional: 劉備一邊穿衣服，一邊跑到外面。出到外面一看，他笑了。

sentences.english: Liu Bei ran outside while putting on his clothes. When he got outside to take a look, he smiled.

sentences.pinyin: chéng wài bú shì lǚ bù de jūn duì shì cáo cāo de jūn duì cáo cāo lái le
sentences.english: It was not Lü Bu’s troops outside the city, but Cao Cao’s troops. Cao Cao had arrived!

sentences.simplified: 刘备没想到曹操只用了四天就到了这里，他高兴极了。
sentences.traditional: 劉備沒想到曹操只用了四天就到了這裡，他高興極了。
sentences.pinyin: liú bèi méi xiǎng dào cáo cāo zhǐ yòng le sì tiān jiù dào le zhè lǐ tā gāo xìng jí le
sentences.english: Liu Bei did not expect that Cao Cao would arrive in only four days. He was extremely happy.

sentences.simplified: 吕布看到曹操的军队，知道自己一定打不过曹操，
sentences.traditional: 呂布看到曹操的軍隊，知道自己一定打不過曹操，

sentences.english: When Lü Bu saw Cao Cao’s troops, he knew that he would definitely be unable to beat Cao Cao.

sentences.simplified: 所以就决定先带军队回徐州，等一等再打。
sentences.traditional: 所以就決定先帶軍隊回徐州，等一等再打。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ jiù jué dìng xiān dài jūn duì huí xú zhōu děng yì děng zài dǎ
sentences.english: So he decided to first take his troops back to Xuzhou and wait a while before fighting.

sentences.simplified: 在回徐州的路上，吕布想了很久，还是觉得很奇怪：不应该啊！
sentences.traditional: 在回徐州的路上，呂布想了很久，還是覺得很奇怪：不應該啊！
sentences.pinyin: zài huí xú zhōu de lù shang lǚ bù xiǎng le hěn jiǔ hái shi jué de hěn qí guài bù yīng gāi a
sentences.english: On the way back to Xuzhou, Lü Bu thought for a long time, but still felt it was very strange: This isn’t right!

sentences.simplified: 曹操在河南，他们要来这里，最快也要十天啊。
sentences.traditional: 曹操在河南，他們要來這裡，最快也要十天啊。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo zài hé nán tā men yào lái zhè lǐ zuì kuài yě yào shí tiān a
sentences.english: Cao Cao was in Henan. It would take them ten days to get here at the earliest.

sentences.simplified: 为什么现在才四天，曹操就到了呢？太奇怪了！这是为什么？
sentences.traditional: 為什麼現在才四天，曹操就到了呢？太奇怪了！這是為什麼？
sentences.pinyin: wèi shén me xiàn zài cái sì tiān cáo cāo jiù dào le ne tài qí guài le zhè shì wèi shén me
sentences.english: How did Cao Cao get in here in just four days? This is very strange! Why did this happen?

sentences.simplified: 吕布边走边想，军队到了徐州市外。
sentences.traditional: 呂布邊走邊想，軍隊到了徐州市外。
sentences.pinyin: lǚ bù biān zǒu biān xiǎng jūn duì dào le xú zhōu shì wài
sentences.english: Lü Bu thought as he walked. The troops arrived outside the city of Xuzhou.

sentences.simplified: 城门关着，吕布觉得更奇怪了：

sentences.pinyin: chéng mén guān zhe lǚ bù jué de gèng qí guài le
sentences.english: The city gates were closed. Lü Bu thought it was even stranger.

sentences.simplified: 耳等知道我回来，为什么不开门呢？
sentences.traditional: 耳等知道我回來，為什麼不開門呢？
sentences.pinyin: ěr děng zhī dào wǒ huí lái wèi shén me bù kāi mén ne
sentences.english: Erdeng knows I have returned. Why didn’t he open the gates?

sentences.simplified: 他对着城门大叫道：“耳等，是我！快开城门！”
sentences.traditional: 他對著城門大叫道：“耳等，是我！快開城門！”

sentences.english: He shouted at the city gates, “Erdeng, it’s me! Open the gates!”

sentences.simplified: 城门还是没开，吕布听到了耳等的笑声。

sentences.pinyin: chéng mén hái shi méi kāi lǚ bù tīng dào le ěr děng de xiào shēng
sentences.english: The city gates still didn’t open, and Lü Bu heard the sound of Erdeng laughing.

sentences.simplified: 只见耳等在城门上面，看着吕布，大声说：
sentences.traditional: 只見耳等在城門上面，看著呂布，大聲說：
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ jiàn ěr děng zài chéng mén shàng miàn kàn zhe lǚ bù dà shēng shuō
sentences.english: He saw Erdeng at the top of the city gates, looking at Lü Bu and saying loudly,

sentences.simplified: “徐州已经是曹将军的了，你如果不想死，就快走吧！”
sentences.traditional: “徐州已經是曹將軍的了，你如果不想死，就快走吧！”
sentences.pinyin: xú zhōu yǐ jīng shì cáo jiāng jūn de le nǐ rú guǒ bù xiǎng sǐ jiù kuài zǒu ba
sentences.english: “Xuzhou now belongs to General Cao. If you don’t want to die, then leave now!”

sentences.simplified: 吕布不敢相信：“什么？你说什么？”

sentences.english: Lü Bu couldn’t believe it: “What? What did you say?”

sentence_translations: Liu Bei ran outside while putting on his clothes. When he got outside to take a look, he smiled.
It was not Lü Bu’s troops outside the city, but Cao Cao’s troops. Cao Cao had arrived!
Liu Bei did not expect that Cao Cao would arrive in only four days. He was extremely happy.
When Lü Bu saw Cao Cao’s troops, he knew that he would definitely be unable to beat Cao Cao.
So he decided to first take his troops back to Xuzhou and wait a while before fighting.
On the way back to Xuzhou, Lü Bu thought for a long time, but still felt it was very strange: This isn’t right!
Cao Cao was in Henan. It would take them ten days to get here at the earliest.
How did Cao Cao get in here in just four days? This is very strange! Why did this happen?
Lü Bu thought as he walked. The troops arrived outside the city of Xuzhou.
The city gates were closed. Lü Bu thought it was even stranger.
Erdeng knows I have returned. Why didn’t he open the gates?
He shouted at the city gates, “Erdeng, it’s me! Open the gates!”
The city gates still didn’t open, and Lü Bu heard the sound of Erdeng laughing.
He saw Erdeng at the top of the city gates, looking at Lü Bu and saying loudly,
“Xuzhou now belongs to General Cao. If you don’t want to die, then leave now!”
Lü Bu couldn’t believe it: “What? What did you say?”
